why: No major reviewer or authority appears in these results; the Lowe's and city PDF results had no text. Everything else is a niche spec calculator or an affiliate listicle, and none of them tested anything. Their sizing assumptions don't agree with each other (nonstop pumping versus 10–20 minutes an hour). A focused page that tests the pump, picks a station for 12 hours and lists current prices would stand out.
